meta.name: agent-decision-receipts
meta.description: Mint a tamper-evident, post-quantum-signed receipt for a consequential agent action (deploy, delete, pay, grant-access, model decision) so it can be verified later from the certificate alone. Use when an autonomous agent takes a side-effecting action that may need to be proven later, or when satisfying EU AI Act Article 12 record-keeping. Three decisions: whether an action needs a receipt, minting it, verifying it. Signing is delegated to the open-source OpenAgentOntology package. Not after-the-fact log analysis; not a hosted notary; not a legal opinion.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为自主代理的关键操作生成防篡改收据，供事后验证。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果自主代理执行了需要事后证明的敏感操作。
copy.tagline_en: Mint tamper-evident receipts for critical agent actions, verifiable later.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your autonomous agent performs sensitive actions that may need proof later.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会判断一个操作是否需要防篡改收据，然后生成并验证它。收据包含谁、做了什么、依据什么规则，并用后量子签名加密，之后可离线验证真伪。
howto.when: 当 Claude 要执行部署、删除、支付、授权等有外部影响且可能被追责的操作时触发。也适用于满足欧盟 AI 法案第 12 条记录义务。

say.text: 帮我为这次部署生成一个收据。
say.note: Claude 会构建操作清单并签名生成收据。

say.text: 验证这个收据是否被篡改过。
say.note: Claude 会检查哈希和签名，返回验证结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude decides whether an action needs a tamper-evident receipt, then mints and verifies it. The receipt records who, what, and under which policy, signed with post-quantum cryptography, and can be verified offline later.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude is about to perform a side-effecting action like deploy, delete, pay, or grant access that may need to be proven later. Also when satisfying EU AI Act Article 12 record-keeping.

say_en.text: Generate a receipt for this deployment.
say_en.note: Claude will build the action manifest and sign it to produce a receipt.

say_en.text: Verify if this receipt has been tampered with.
